aliasNotes: Source SEARCH_PROVIDER_ALIASES maps duckduckgo -> duckduckgo-free. Local duckduckgo-web (DuckDuckGo AI Chat, serviceKinds llm) owns alias 'ddgw' and uiAlias 'ddg'; neither is reused.

exports.index.js: public staging exports (config.js, adapter.js except invalid, service.js)

discovery: none: the source has no model catalog or discovery endpoint for duckduckgo-free

auth.identity: selected no-auth connection only selects proxy and accounting scope (connectionId); no credential value is ever sent; no refresh, cache, replay or failover

envelope.request: Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; User-Agent: <source Chrome UA>; Accept: text/html; body q=<sanitized query>
envelope.response: { provider: 'duckduckgo-free', query, results: [unified SearchResult], answer: null, usage: { queries_used: 1, search_cost_usd: 0 }, metrics, errors: [] } parsed from lite HTML (result-link anchors + result-snippet cells)

integration.provider: new open-sse/providers/registry/duckduckgo-free.js from duckduckgo-free ProviderDefinition (noAuth, serviceKinds webSearch, searchConfig) plus open-sse/providers/registry/index.js entry
integration.search: open-sse/handlers/search/index.js handleSearchCore: dispatch handleDuckDuckGoFreeSearchNative for provider 'duckduckgo-free' before tryDedicatedProvider; the generic JSON path (callers.js/normalizers.js) cannot parse HTML and has no builder for this id
integration.route: src/sse/handlers/search.js noAuth branch already resolves getNoAuthProviderCredentials and passes the connection; recordSuccess consumes accounting.nativeUnits.operations=1 with costPerQuery 0
integration.fallbackOnly: source fallbackOnly auto-selection (no configured provider) is a route policy, not wired at staging; registration decides whether to adopt it
integration.catalog: docs/providers/catalog.mdx, public/providers icon and shared catalogs updated at serial registration only

restrictions: unregistered pending serial registration after four additions
search_type 'web' only; country, language, time_range, offset, domain_filter, content_options and provider_options must be absent/null/empty (source silently ignored them)
query sanitized like local sanitizeQuery and bounded to 2000 characters; max_results integer 1..100 clamped to 25 (default 5)
10s default/15s maximum total deadline; 1MiB success and 16KiB error body bounds; parser input truncated to 256KiB as in the source
manual redirects refused; response origin must be https://lite.duckduckgo.com
result URLs must be http(s), without userinfo, not literal internal/loopback/metadata hosts, at most 2048 characters
anti-bot anomaly page, 202 and 429 surface as 429 rateLimited instead of the source's empty-success or 502
upstream bodies and error text are never relayed
no upstream cost receipt: accounting costStatus unknown with nativeUnits.operations 1
no streaming, media, async jobs, polling, browser or WebSocket protocol
